items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: some guy named Cherry. Don Cherry?

ctx.x: and said, "Get back on that stand." And I put my coat on, and then I said to Lester...Lester got his horn and I got my gun out and put it under my coat and said, "Let's go." We walked out. And the musicians are still wondering how we didn't get killed, you know, defying the guy. But that's exactly what happened. He said, "Get back on that stand." And I said, "Shit, (you know) you got to be kidding." I said, "I wonder if he know who he's talking to." The other guy...all the musicians standing there playing like…

But the thing that ...always, whenever I was involved in music there (was) always something exciting happening. In 1975 we went to Pescara in Italy...Ray Bryant, Art Hodes/ piano summit. And they had a lot of...a host of musicians. And when we got to Italy, to Pescara, and got into that park, some guy named Cherry. Don Cherry?
